timer.title: Timer
timer.buttonHint: Press and hold to undo the last tap
timer.howBody1: Tap Start when a contraction begins and Stop when it ends. The app works out how long each one lasts and how far apart they are.
timer.howBody2: The gap is measured from the start of one contraction to the start of the next, the way midwives and doctors usually count.
timer.howBody3: If your provider gave you a pattern to watch for, such as 5-1-1, choose it in More, then Settings. The app only compares your numbers with it. Your provider decides what to do.
timer.clockChanged: Phone clock changed — times may be off
timer.longRunning: Still going? Tap Stop when it eases. If something feels wrong, call your provider.
timer.idlePrompt: Looks like things calmed down. End this session?
timer.undoBody: This takes back your last Start or Stop.

kicks.title: Kicks
kicks.tip: Find a comfortable spot. Tap once for each movement. Movements within a second of each other count as one.
kicks.startedTip: Tap Start whenever you're ready to count.

kicks.historyEmpty: No counts yet. When you save one, it will be kept here, only on this phone.
kicks.sparkLabel: Minutes to reach the target over your last {n} counts: from {first} to {last}

stats.tapHint: Tap to see what this means
stats.explainCount: How many contractions you timed in the last 60 minutes. Very short taps, under 10 seconds, are left out because they are most likely a mis-tap.
stats.explainLength: The average time from the start to the end of each contraction in the last hour.
stats.explainInterval: The average time from the start of one contraction to the start of the next, over the last hour. A gap of more than 30 minutes is left out.

onboarding.welcomeTitle: Hi there. Let's keep this simple.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Time contractions with one big button, count your baby's kicks, and keep a clear summary ready for your midwife or doctor. Everything stays on this phone.
onboarding.disclaimerBody: This app helps you keep track. It isn't a medical device and doesn't give medical advice. Your midwife, doctor or hospital always knows best. If you're worried — about pain, bleeding, your waters, or your baby moving less — call them or emergency services right away.
onboarding.firstFooter: This only changes tips. You can change it anytime.
onboarding.needsTitle: What would help most right now?
onboarding.needTracking: Following my pregnancy week by week
onboarding.remindMe: Remind me to count kicks every day at {time}
onboarding.remindLabel: Remind me to count kicks every day
onboarding.remindDenied: No problem. You can turn reminders on later in More.
onboarding.remindBlocked: Notifications are turned off for this app in your phone's settings. You can change that later in More.
onboarding.coachMark: When a contraction starts, tap here. That's it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.alertsHint: A soft message when your recent contractions match the rule you chose. It never says you are in labor.
settings.partnerHint: Bigger text and fewer buttons on the Timer, for whoever is holding the phone.
settings.hapticsHint: A buzz when you start and stop, and when your kicks are counted.
settings.weeklyHint: A note once a week on how big your baby is. It needs notifications to be allowed on your phone.

rule.title: Pattern rule
rule.intro: Pick the rule your provider gave you. The app only compares your numbers with it.
rule.describe: Contractions {interval} minutes apart or less, {length} seconds long or more, for {sustain} minutes.
rule.note: Always follow what your provider told you, and call them whenever you are worried, whatever the app shows.

privacy.title: Privacy and ads
privacy.onDevice: Everything you enter stays on this phone: your contractions, kick counts, due date, notes and checklists. There is no account and no cloud, and nothing is sent to us.
privacy.sharing: A summary leaves your phone only when you share it, and only to the app you choose.
privacy.ads: The app is supported by ads from Google AdMob. There are no ads on the Timer or Kicks screens, and no full-screen ads while you are timing contractions or counting kicks, or for a while afterwards. To show ads, Google may receive your phone's advertising ID, approximate location and how you use ads. None of your health entries are sent.
privacy.notifications: Reminders are made on your phone. The app asks for permission only when you turn one on.
privacy.choices: Where the law requires it, you can change your ad choices below.

disclaimerScreen.title: Medical disclaimer
disclaimerScreen.general: The week cards, sizes and tips are general information. The pattern alert only compares your numbers with a rule you chose. Neither can tell you whether you or your baby are well. Your midwife, doctor or hospital can.

about.title: About
about.name: Contraction Timer & Kick Count
about.body: A calm contraction timer, kick counter and due date tool. It works offline, with no account.
about.local: Your data stays on this phone.
